surface the document date in the retrieval passage headers

BREAKING: `SemanticChunkResult` gains a required `fileCreatedAt`. It is a public export of this
package, so any external code that CONSTRUCTS one (an alternative retrieval backend, a hand-rolled
mock) must now supply it; code that only READS the type is unaffected. Required rather than
optional on purpose - it is what forced the ANN path to carry the date, and optional would have
compiled clean while one retrieval backend served dateless passages.
